note: S-I18N-W1a — per-key provenance for the ar catalogue in this directory. `machine` = produced by scripts/i18n-translate.mjs and NOT yet read by a human. `reviewed` = a human signed off; the pipeline never overwrites it. `stale` = the Persian source changed after a human review — the ar text on disk is the last reviewed one and needs a human, not a re-run.
